question: Photons are electrically neutral particles. How does this property affect their behavior when a beam of light passes through strong electric and magnetic fields?

options.A: They are deflected towards the positive plate of the electric field
options.B: They are deflected in a circular path by the magnetic field
options.C: They are not deflected by either electric or magnetic fields
options.D: They are accelerated but not deflected
